name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta province of Argentina, one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally with 248 million ounces silver and 2.54 million ounces gold in measured and indicated resources. A preliminary feasibility study has been completed, demonstrating strong project economics with a US$494M after-tax NPV. The company also holds the earlier-stage La Coipita copper-gold project in San Juan, Argentina, currently being advanced under an earn-in partnership with Teck Resources Ltd.
